The snapshot looks like late 2025 or early 2026. The fed funds rate is 3.64%, which fits after cuts in September, October and December 2025. The unemployment rate is 4.6%, which matches November 2025. Gold is up 64% over 12 months, which fits a period around December 2025. The dollar is down 7.4% year on year, also consistent with late 2025.

The fed funds rate is the main cue for the month. The effective rate was about 3.64% in December 2025, after the cut on December 10 to a 3.50–3.75% target range. It was 3.87% in October and about 3.88% in November. The 3-month change of -0.45 from roughly 4.09% in September fits December.

The unemployment rate was 4.6% in November 2025 and 4.4% in December. Because data are published with lags, the latest value as of the end of December would be November's 4.6%. The 10-year yield of 4.14% also fits late December. Core CPI of 2.62% is low, which fits the distorted November CPI release.

I estimate December 2025.
